description: Cast a vote for a mayoral candidate in an active neighborhood election. Prerequisite: caller must be a resident of the target neighborhood (fso_roommates on a lot in nhood), must not have moved in <30 days (Election_Move_Penalty; admins bypass), the neighborhood must have an active election_cycle in state='election', and the target must be a running candidate. Effect: fso_election_votes row INSERT (primary key election_cycle_id+from_avatar_id+type='vote' — vote is idempotent per cycle). Returns SUCCESS. Refuse paths: ELECTION_OVER (no active cycle), BAD_STATE (cycle in nomination phase not election), NOT_IN_NHOOD, ALREADY_VOTED, CANDIDATE_NOT_NOMINATED, YOU_MOVED_RECENTLY, CANDIDATE_MOVED_RECENTLY, INVALID_AVATAR. An active election cycle is set up by scripts/show/election-day.sh (run by the orchestrator before an embodied election run); without that setup, vote refuses with ELECTION_OVER. Wire: NhoodRequest{Type=VOTE, TargetAvatar, TargetNHood} on city Aries; resolves on the next NhoodResponse.

args.name: target_persist_id
args.description: Hex or decimal persist_id of the candidate avatar. Mutually exclusive with target_avatar_name — if both are supplied, target_avatar_name takes precedence (I0-5 name-primary invariant).

args.name: target_avatar_name
args.description: Name-store binding of the candidate avatar (kind=sim). Resolved to target_persist_id via the sidecar naming store. Takes precedence over target_persist_id when both are supplied. Preferred call shape per I0-5 name-primary invariant.

call_signatures: cf $CF vote --target_avatar_name <name>                                                                          # preferred: resolve name from store (kind=sim); defaults neighborhood_id=1

cf $CF vote --target_persist_id <candidate_persist_id>                                                          # fallback: hex/decimal persist_id; defaults neighborhood_id=1; refuses ELECTION_OVER if no active cycle
common_mistakes: target_avatar_name not bound in name store (or bound with wrong kind) → ok:false with name-resolution error.
target_persist_id = 0 or missing (and no target_avatar_name) → ok:false.
Server returns NHOOD_NO_ELECTION or ELECTION_OVER when no active cycle exists (election-day.sh must run first) → ok:false.
YOU_MOVED_RECENTLY if caller moved in last 30 days (non-admin).
perception_hints: Neighborhood id (defaults to 1 on workshop): perception.lot.lot_id is a lot id, not a nhood id — most ops default nhood_id to 1
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-vote/self-nominate): perception.avatar.persist_id
Your lot membership (residency gate): perception.lot.owner_is_me or check is_roommate via query-lot
refuse_conditions: target_avatar_name present but not bound in name store → ok:false with name-resolution error
target_avatar_name bound with kind != sim → ok:false (name must be a sim binding)
neither target_avatar_name nor target_persist_id provided, or target_persist_id <= 0 → ok:false
target resolves to own avatar_id → ok:false with 'cannot vote for yourself'
server NHOOD_NO_ELECTION / ELECTION_OVER → ok:false with response code
